glosses: by (an organization acting as a body)
(before a noun) …'s; made/held by — 委員会での決定 "the committee's decision"
patterns.usage_note: Agentive で names a place, body or set of people as the one acting, not the site of the action: 警察で調べる means the police are doing the investigating. The usual test is that swapping in が leaves the meaning intact. It attaches to nouns denoting organizations or groupings (会社, 委員会, みんな, 二人), and before a noun it appears as での (委員会での決定).

examples.ruby: その件[けん]は警察[けいさつ]で調[しら]べているそうだ。
examples.english: I hear the police are looking into that matter.

examples.ruby: 引[ひ]っ越[こ]しの費用[ひよう]は会社[かいしゃ]で負担[ふたん]してくれる。
examples.english: The company covers the moving expenses for us.

examples.ruby: 文化祭[ぶんかさい]の出[だ]し物[もの]はクラスでの話[はな]し合[あ]いで決[き]まった。
examples.english: What our class would do for the school festival was settled in a class discussion.
